notes.title: June 2025 - Steam Demo!
notes.content:
[h2]Next Liquidation Demo is here![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134458/bce03d78f4860a39b1bdefce734de8ec162569a3.jpg[/img]

Starting June 3rd, 2025 - the new Liquidation demo will be live for one week only!

In the demo you can:
[list]
[*] Battle the AI in classic skirmish mode
[*] Face off against other players (lobby based, no matchmaking)
[*] Play the recently announced King of the Hill mode
[*] Watch replays
[*] Command any of the three currently available factions:
[list]
[*]   The Twilight Crusade
[*]   The Legion
[*]   The Scourge Alliance
[/list][/list]
[h2] What changed since the last demo? [/h2]

In some ways - a lot has changed. In others, things feel familiar.

First off, the commander system has been replaced with a hero system - something you might recognize from a certain legendary fantasy RTS.

We’ve also made further improvements to pathfinding and collision avoidance, boosting both unit behavior and overall game performance.

Then, of course - we added:
[list]
[*] The Scourge Alliance
[*] King of the Hill mode
[*] New visual and effects and polish
[*] New voices
[*] New icons & unit portraits!
[*] New environments
[/list]

[h2]Join us[/h2]

We hope to hear your feedback regarding the demo, you're welcome to join our Discord, follow us on X or Bluesky, or tag us on your favorite platform. Every comment counts!

[b]Our future is in your hands.[/b]

👉 [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/896250/Liquidation/]Wishlist now[/url][/b] to show your support! It really helps a lot.
👉 Join our [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/liquidation]Discord[/url][/b]

notes.title: The Scourge - new faction reveal!
notes.content:
[h2]The Scourge Alliance[/h2]

Please, welcome the third fully playable race in Liquidation - the Scourge Alliance!
Rising from the depths below the ground, the Scourge bring with them an arsenal of highly advanced technology and a force unlike anything the surface dwellers have faced before.

[i]The gloomy and enigmatic underworld that lies under the endless sands of the buried city of Al’akam was reawakened during the catastrophe.[/i]

The Scourge Alliance consists of many different creatures, with Lamias and Toadkin forming the backbone of their armies. Some of their units are equipped with energy shields that reduce incoming damage, thus giving them a formidable edge in battle.

In the event of another demo coming out anytime soon, The Scourge will be available. All frog and lizard fans - your time to shine has come!
 
[i]With technology never seen before by the surface dwellers, the Scourge Alliances unyielding advance into enemy territory... Not to quell their thirst for Quenrium, but in pursuit of the truth about the catastrophe that decimated the world[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134458/27a37e5fcd089ba69f5a27de32b4abdbe894567d.png[/img]

Curious to see them in action? Here's a look at Scourge gameplay:

notes.title: New Game Mode!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We had some discussions on the Community Discord in February and March about introducing new game modes to Liquidation. 

From those discussions sprung King of the Hill mode, now it's live in the game and fully playable! 

[h3]How does it work?[/h3]
In [b]King of the Hill[/b] (KOTH), you can win by either wiping out your opponents or reaching the target number of Victory Points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134458/35939e9d66c096a6bd118ce671da431c891ce91e.png[/img]
[i]Victory Points counter at the top right of the screen.[/i]

[h3]Monoliths[/h3]
In order to earn Victory Points, a player needs to capture and hold Monoliths.
Send any infantry unit (not vehicles) to one, and they'll begin capturing. You will see a clear progress indicator near the structure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134458/d290d9e6874436b7cb5d4d6a65ded015a488cc60.png[/img]
[i]An Engineer from the Crusade capturing a Monolith.[/i]

Capturing enemy-held Monoliths takes away 100 points from player, so aggressive play pays off.
This redemption mechanic will allow you to rip victory away from your opponents hands, if they don't guard their Monoliths well enough!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134458/49e62fbdb8e311dda83f0d7d93d75cb6376249bf.png[/img]
[i]The Monoliths as visible on the minimap. The central one is not captured. Yet.[/i]

Want to see KOTH in action?
Check out this match recording:
[previewyoutube=ipB_S9E-UKs;full]<video embed>[/previewyoutube]


[i]The Legion aims to consume. 
The Crusade marches towards dominance.[/i]
[b][i]What's next?[/i][/b]

------

notes.title: Update - Pathfinding Improvements
notes.content:
Long time no see! We've had a huge break from writing news, but the game development didn't stop even for a moment in that time. Actually, there's been a lot of exciting things happening behind the scenes.

Anyway, today it's time to talk about Pathfinding in Liquidation.

There've been some significant updates recently, and it's time to share them with the community! 
To start the topic, here's a dev view of how buildings can now look on the pathfinding grid in Liquidation:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134458/47e3c4ac391e284316b48f84bc30b60f566f453a.png[/img]

It's important to note that before this round of changes, the buildings were simple rectangles on the pathfinding grid. Now, the shapes on the grid match the actual buildings much better.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134458/5c0a0443a65edc40a861949168fc53d2e2bc103a.png[/img]

The consequence of them being simple rectangles was as simple as the following picture present. The units weren't able to sneak through corners. But now, after the change - they can. 
[i]That also means Dominus can finally walk between the two buildings and deal decisive blows to anyone who dares to oppose the Twilight Crusade![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134458/471769fdf5ca6a8d2096e2ad448c7d5bd804e352.png[/img]

Now that we've got that out of the way - let's move on to the meat of this news post.

You might remember from the news about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/896250/view/7950611950253970692]Corrupt Nether Environment[/url] that idle avoidance response got improved in Liquidation. That was another one of the steps towards what's shown below. 

Using other avoidance behaviors, Local Avoidance introduction improved unit behavior around buildings. 
After that, and a few updates later, we've arrived at the results you can inspect on the video here:

[i]The Corruption raids a Twilight Crusade outpost, who's going to win this battle? Will it influence the war efforts?[/i] 
[previewyoutube=nauYBTG7YiM;full][/previewyoutube]

Please share your thoughts! 
Maybe you want to ask a question about the Corruption appearance in this news post? Ask away!

------

notes.title: Weekly Update - Translations
notes.content:
This week, we're ready to announce that Liquidation now supports community translations! We will be looking for people to help with translations in the future, so keep your eyes peeled for further news, as this is a community-driven effort!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134458/ab116575b836bfe16c6ecef45d184a883804bd14.png[/img]

For starters, we ran an automatic translation to the Korean language. Next, we invited the community to begin translating the game to Spanish and Polish languages. The system seems to work, which bodes well for the future. We're still testing and uncovering bugs. 
The screenshots you can see here present some elements of the Polish translation of the game. There are still some kinks to be worked out with the fonts, but nothing we can't accomplish over time.

One of the features that we want to keep in the game is switching between languages in the game on the fly. You can change the language in the settings even during a match. Currently, we're testing English, German, Polish, Spanish, and Korean texts, as it seems people speaking those languages are waiting for the game the most, according to our Wishlist data.
Incomplete translations will have their missing texts keep the English versions. 

Please let us know what languages you'd like to see next for the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134458/bf5db1c817d2371db82a322db43da65acdf389fc.png[/img]

notes.title: Weekly Update - Corrupted Nether Environment
notes.content:
In the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/896250/announcements/detail/4024598238779766416]news last week[/url] we announced the Legion faction is almost finished. There, you might've learned that the Nether started to consume the fabrics of reality, and now it's reflected in the corrupted Nether environment.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134458/315fd5138e49de031e35ef147df6a2122f8663e0.png[/img]

This change should allow the world to be much more filled, which is one of the most important things to address before Liquidation is ready for Early Access. 

Which part of this environment do you like the most? What's the thing you'd like to see next? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134458/de1a2fe8216e6d812eb56815ad015974587f089e.png[/img]

We've also improved the idle avoidance response, but what does that mean? 
While playing RTS games, you might've noticed that units need to interact with each other when not directly controlled - for example - when a group of your units is passing through your idle army.
After introducing unit collision a while back, we faced a problem - idle units often blocked moving ones... So here's a demo of how it works now, where Husks - Legion faction workers - are running around other Husks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134458/aaf4e741ac086a1487959e70302a43dae0a5a1b6.gif[/img]

notes.title: 33% in 48 hours. Off to a great start!
notes.content:
We are amazed by how generous the RTS community is. Although our backer numbers are not that high, the average donation certainly is! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134458/3c8530cbc76025d55889960c7cc10b476e615ebf.jpg[/img]

I think that we, as an RTS community, might not be strong in numbers, but we make up for it with our dedication to the genre. This is what our great start means to me. And that is genuinely great motivation for us to deliver Liquidation to this community. 

Demo
Quite a few streamers played our demo, and you can find a playlist of such videos here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLOF0G9xABg6cwItAfcAJSY-RGKmKNMr6W

Some did great, and some didn't manage to finish up the mission. Perhaps they were expecting less of a challenge ;). But here at the studio, we love the challenge, both in our level design and in our work lives.

In the end, all that matters is that people had fun with it! 

More than 1000 players also downloaded the demo! And you had a lot of comments and suggestions. That shows a real passion for Liquidation and RTS genre. Just please don't try to contact me directly :( You had... a lot... a lot of suggestions. 

This event brought us to an idea! You can expect a Poll about the demo, your likes, and dislikes of what you have experienced in a few upcoming days. It became apparent from your involvement that this is an excellent opportunity to analyze our strengths and patch up our weaknesses!

PS.:
For those of you who did not hear about our KS until now: 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/liquidation/liquidation-a-rts-rpg-hybrid

You have the last chance to get an Early Bird special package, as it expires in few hours. If you want to get your hands on the game as soon as possible, this package contains a Digital copy with Early access included + some other goodies! 

Thank you all!
And have a great day.

notes.title: Playable Character Profile: Dominus
notes.content:
[b][h1]What's up Deities?[/h1][/b]


Today's character profile features one of our latest created characters which is one of the leaders of the Twilight Crusade faction.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134458/98098e3f91aa5f1709cb9f801a2685744bd3f00d.png[/img]
[b][h1]Twilight King Dominus Ailwing[/h1][/b]
[b]Race:[/b] Human/Soul-eater
[b]Age:[/b] 3,161 years (Immortal)
[b]Origin:[/b] Pryht
[b]Height:[/b] 332 cm
[b]Weight:[/b] Unknown
[b]Gender:[/b] Male
[b]Bloodtype:[/b] A+
[b]Affiliation:[/b] Twilight Crusade
[b]Occupation:[/b] Twilight King (Leader of the Twilight Crusade)
[b]Relative(s):[/b] Falira (Lover), Shira (Sister), Gishmel (Father)


[b]Personality:[/b] Dominus’ personality is conflicted due to the nature of his being, he usually cycles between an apathetic state and a more emotional one. Despite this inner conflict he tends to be very focused on the events unfolding and is a master strategist on the battlefield. From the teachings of his father Dominus tends to be protective of those close to him, even going so far to willingly give his life for theirs.


[b]Likes:[/b] Honor, Discipline, Swordplay

[b]Dislikes:[/b] Lies, Losing control, Individuals without honor


[b]Background:[/b] Dominus is a human cursed with immortality, brother to Shira, son of Gishmel, beloved of Falira and current bearer of the Curse of Life.

Dominus never learnt the art of magic as he was denied this by his own father but was instead told myths of ancient times.

When Gishmel died, Dominus and Shira ascended the throne but failed to uphold the Church of Illuminus. They later formed the Twilight Crusade to vanquish the monstrosities of Ulkatan and return peace to the realm.

Throughout his rule he held a close relationship with the elven woman Falira who was saved by Gishmel from the Tempus Cage ages ago. Though once told by his own father that no soul-eater should ever engage in love he ignored this fact and continued.

After the war against the Jul’avum Empire and its allies and the consequent event of the Splintering, Dominus held a firm grasp on the throne to overpower the Crusade’s enemies.

notes.title: Unit - Weapons & Equipment
notes.content:
[b][h1]What's up Deities?[/h1][/b]


Today we want to talk a little bit about what we are currently working on.


Liquidation is a real time strategy game which includes several tactical elements such as using the environment as cover for your units.


But this is just one of the features which we are currently working on.


Today we want to give a short insight about the weapons in Liquidation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134458/619d618599f4a52c3db70535457b29a0fc41911a.png[/img]

In Liquidation it is possible to equip most of your units with different kinds of equipment and weapons, changing how they behave and attack. 


Equipping new weapons changes stats like attack speed, attack range, damage, attack types and even movement speed as well as defensive values. 


However, these units will usually not be able to change their designated role such as changing a squishy ranged unit into a melee tank.


In case you are curious on what kind of weapons we are currently working on, we have attached a few concept artworks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134458/4ced173e7cebff2b6e026fc15bd0c5d18af67411.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134458/9ca58fc6823a258aba1c2669a4efca3c39c32f56.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134458/bdae994266ee60a74162ca0f4c44e6df7e7d7fb2.png[/img]

We plan to reveal more detailed information about the game in the upcoming months together with the launch of the first teaser and gameplay trailer.


Until the next update!

notes.title: Playable Character Profile: Celeste
notes.content:
[b][h1]What's up Deities?[/h1][/b]

Since the background story is very important to us, we want to start a series of character profiles beginning with this post which will give a small insight into the background of each playable character in our fantasy/sci-fi singleplayer and multiplayer real-time strategy hybrid LIQUIDATION, a game in which you take the role of a Deity to bring back balance to the devastated and war-torn world of Veá.


We are also planning to reveal some addtional gameplay information about them in the future which will include their abilties and role on the battlefield for the people who are more interested in gameplay.


You can also expect a game teaser and a trailer in the coming months when we get closer to our kickstarter campaign launch and of course the launch of the game itself.


Today's character profile features one of our latest created characters which is one of the leaders of the Scourge faction, an alliance of poisonous reptile creatures which excels in early harassing attacks.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134458/b4fdc53440128871cfba67b703f312fb0626dcc7.png[/img]
[b][h1]High Priestess Celeste Xelsius[/h1][/b]
[b]Race:[/b] Basilisk Lamia
[b]Age:[/b] 107 years
[b]Origin:[/b] Vrathor
[b]Height:[/b] 254 cm
[b]Weight:[/b] 198 kg
[b]Gender:[/b] Female
[b]Bloodtype:[/b] AB-
[b]Affiliation:[/b] Scourge Alliance
[b]Occupation:[/b] High Priestess & Advisor of the Scourge Alliance
[b]Relative(s):[/b] Aeternus (Husband)


[b]Personality:[/b] Celeste is a very religious person. Having spent much of her youth in a temple, she found enjoyment in praying and healing magic. She has a motherly personality, and so can't ignore people in need, being always prone to help her people if there's a problem. She tends to let people tell her what to do, rationalizing this to be the will of the Gods.


[b]Likes:[/b] Praying, Herbalism, Singing

[b]Dislikes:[/b] Violence, Herself


[b]Background:[/b] Celeste is a rare lamia basilisk, the high priestess of the Scourge Alliance, the wife of Prophet Aeternus and a sorceress capable of casting magic through her voice.

Throughout her youth she struggled due to her paralyzing gaze, unintentionally inflicting pain upon others which caused her to embrace solitude to protect those she held dear.

Holding unto her faith and the enjoyment of singing she tried to overcome solitude until a fellow lamia who was able to resist her gaze gave her the hope she needed to escape her despair.

After the cataclysmic event of the Splintering she united the races of the hollow worlds alongside her husband, forming the Scourge Alliance.
With the appearance of the resource of quenrium, the Scourge Alliance went to war against the Twilight Crusade despite her plead of resolving the issue peacefully.
